#!/bin/sh
# Wrapper to ensure Steam launched from Fuzzel has the X11 env it needs.
# Use this if Fuzzel launches Steam without inheriting DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY.
export DISPLAY="${DISPLAY:-:0}"
export XAUTHORITY="${XAUTHORITY:-$HOME/.Xauthority}"
exec /usr/bin/steam "$@"
